::: {#def-causal-mask}

#### Causal mask

A **causal mask** sets the score of key $j$ for query $i$ to $-\infty$
whenever $j > i$,
before the [softmax](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/multiclass-logistic-regression.html#def-softmax) in [self-attention](#def-self-attention).
The softmax then gives those keys weight 0,
so each position attends only to itself and the positions before it
[@vaswani2017attention, section 3.2.3].

:::
